description: Stably sort data records by an explicit zero-based column using literal code-unit string order, asc or desc. Header defaults to preserved. No numeric, date or locale inference. Reject missing target columns.

column.description: Zero-based column index. Every data record must contain this column.

csv.description: Complete UTF-8 CSV text, up to 256 KiB. All cells remain strings; formulas are never evaluated.

hasHeader.description: Preserve the first record as a header.

name: sort_csv_rows
title: Sort CSV rows
